M-READ-CLASSIFIER.Purpose: Provide one deterministic shell read classifier, shared by every harness adapter, so all integrations observe the same read facts from shell tool calls.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Parsing shell scripts into best-effort read file paths via the pinned upstream Codex shell-command classifier.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: A stdin/stdout JSON transport executable for non-Rust adapters.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Path resolution against a working directory; model-visibility, installation-subtree, or deduplication policy beyond order preservation.
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: Core invocation, ancestor resolution, or FLI semantics of any kind.

Requirements.REQ-001: `classify_reads(script)` returns the upstream classifier's `Read` paths deduplicated in first-seen order; non-read or ambiguous commands yield no paths.
Requirements.REQ-002: The classifier returns paths verbatim from parsing; relative paths stay relative and are resolved by the calling adapter against its own reliable command cwd.
Requirements.REQ-003: The transport executable reads `{"commands": [...]}` and writes `{"reads": [...]}`; malformed input or failed execution is a nonzero exit with a stderr diagnostic, never a guessed empty success.
Requirements.REQ-004: The upstream classifier dependency is pinned to the same revision across all consumers; builds are lockfile-pinned and offline-reproducible.
Requirements.REQ-005: One classification implementation: adapters classify shell reads only through this package, never through local forks of the upstream classifier.
Requirements.REQ-006: The classifier returns exactly what the pinned upstream classifier reports and never invents or filters read facts.
Requirements.REQ-007: The package knows no harness, hook surface, or session concept.

Outputs.OUT-001: Library: read path strings deduplicated in first-seen order.
